title: Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transamin
question: Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range by ascending order of their date of birth.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.BirthdayYear ASC, T1.BirthdayMonth ASC, T1.BirthdayDay ASC
